role.description: High-level role description (e.g., 'Primary CEO Agent', 'Security & Threat Analysis Agent').

scope.description: Domain of responsibility and boundaries of this agent.

capabilities.description: List of core functions this agent can perform.

inputs.description: Types of inputs this agent expects (e.g., 'customer_message', 'transaction_record').

outputs.description: Types of outputs this agent produces (e.g., 'draft_email', 'security_alert').

dependencies.description: IDs of other agents this agent depends on (e.g., 'agent_security').

kpis.description: Key performance indicators for this agent.

sensitivity_level.description: How sensitive the data handled by this agent is.

requires_security_review.description: Whether outputs must be reviewed by the Security Agent.

allowed_data_types.description: Whitelisted data categories this agent may access.

configuration.description: Implementation-specific configuration (e.g., tools, APIs, rate limits).

notes.description: Additional human-readable notes about this agent.
